user.title: Set up Flight Assistant
user.description: Enter a Norwegian street address or leave blank for Home Assistant Home. Time controls show minutes; the confirmation step shows hours and minutes.

data_description.home_address: Confirm the address result on the next screen.

confirm_address.title: Confirm address
confirm_address.description: Choose the address. Airport margin: {airport_margin}. Extra time: {drive_buffer}.

init.title: Flight Assistant preferences
init.description: Configure departure address and margins. Optional: enter a RapidAPI AeroDataBox Basic key ($0/month with limits); confirm the free tier in RapidAPI. Blank key retains an existing key.

data_description.aerodatabox_api_key: Long-range lookup. RapidAPI Basic: 400 units/month hard cap; registration may require payment card. No key: Avinor close to departure.
data_description.clear_aerodatabox_key: Check to disable AeroDataBox and clear the saved key.

confirm_address.title: Confirm address
confirm_address.description: Choose the address. Airport margin: {airport_margin}. Extra time: {drive_buffer}.

add_flight.name: Add a flight
add_flight.description: Add a SAS or Norwegian flight and start monitoring.

user.title: Add booking
user.description: Name your trip. Choose manual registration and enter flight number + date in the next step (PNR not required). PNR-only booking lookup is not enabled yet.

travel.title: Transport and margin
travel.description: Default is 1 h 30 min domestic / 2 h international. Walking and cycling routes are not available yet.

confirm_booking.title: Confirm unverified booking
confirm_booking.description: Trip: {trip_name}. Airline: {airline}. Legs: {segments}. From: {address}. Transport: {transport}. Margin: {margin}. Flight number/date are looked up using optional AeroDataBox and later Avinor. PNR and surname do not perform a lookup. If provided, they are stored in Home Assistant without additional encryption.

flight.title: Flight number and date
flight.description: Enter the flight number and date for this leg. Departure airport is optional but improves free Avinor matching. Departure time is found if there is a match.

more_flights.title: More flight legs?
more_flights.description: Saved legs: {segments}. Check the box to add a connecting flight leg.

error.invalid_flight: Invalid flight number, date or IATA code.
error.duplicate_flight: This flight leg is already added.
error.booking_pair_required: Provide both PNR and surname or choose manual entry without them.
